seed_mixtures.name: NT Tortoise Food Mix
seed_mixtures.ratios_basis: percent of mix as listed by the supplier
seed_mixtures.cultivation_notes: Supplier text: sow outside at 20 g per square metre or into trays inside at 50 g per square metre; about 3 weeks between tray sowings.
seed_mixtures.note: The supplier lists 21 species totalling 100%. 'Convulvus' is the supplier's spelling.

seed_mixtures.name: Tlady mixture (Tortoise Food - Growing from Seed Guide, Autumn 2014)
seed_mixtures.target_tortoise_species: not stated; the guide mentions juvenile tortoises
seed_mixtures.ratios_basis: percent as listed in the guide
seed_mixtures.cultivation_notes: Guide text: use normal unfertilised garden soil or sterilised loam, because some of the plants can accumulate excessive nitrates from artificially enriched soils; allow some plants to flower; graze sections in rotation.
seed_mixtures.note: The guide says 'Twenty One of the following species are included' and prints sainfoin twice (2% each time); it is entered once here. The listed percentages do not add up to 100%.

seed_mixtures.name: Tortoise seed mix (Growing Wildflower Plants from Seed for Tortoise Food)
seed_mixtures.cultivation_notes: Guide text: sow in early spring or early autumn; use top soil, not compost, so plants do not grow too rich; a 7 g bag covers 1 square metre; do not feed young plants especially to hatchlings; allow some plants to flower.
seed_mixtures.observed_consumption: The guide describes the mix as based on plants grazed in the wild and readily eaten in captivity; no observation data are given.
seed_mixtures.note: The guide says 'Ten of the following species are included in seed mix' and lists exactly ten.

seed_mixtures.name: Nutritious Tortoise Seed Mix
seed_mixtures.cultivation_notes: Supplier text: seed only, must be germinated before feeding; for outdoor pens, runs and garden areas.
